title: Normalized coefficient and complete restriction interfaces
statement: For the constant finite and completed coefficient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and derived quotient towers [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], normalized restriction data consist of coefficient isomorphisms fixed by constant sections and completion projections, exact sectionwise module restriction, and compatibility of derived reductions, counits, augmented quotient towers, completeness and local Tor bounds. These are precisely the existing definitions and structures of that node, factored into an interface module without altering their bodies or signatures.

The covering argument is Tag 098F, lemma-w-contractible-proetale-cover, expanded from categorical weak contractibility; exact evaluation is Tag 0946, sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-w-contractible. Parent proof steps 2-3.
